name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, download-once app that clones voices, designs new ones from a text description, dubs videos into other languages, and transcribes speech — running entirely on your own computer, with no cloud subscription required.
buyer: An indie podcaster, YouTuber, or small audiobook publisher who currently pays a cloud voice service monthly and wants the same capability for free, offline, with no per-minute fees.
business_use_cases: A YouTuber dubs their English videos into Spanish and Hindi in-house to reach new audiences, instead of paying a dubbing studio per video.
A small audiobook producer uses the voice-cloning and audiobook-creation workflow to turn one narrator's voice into dozens of titles without re-booking studio time.
An indie game studio generates character voice lines from text descriptions for localization testing before committing budget to professional voice actors.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'done-for-you' dubbing and voiceover service built on top of the free tool, charging per project.
Sell a managed cloud version, hosted so clients don't need a GPU, with monthly minutes included.
Charge for a curated voice-pack marketplace of designed voices for specific genres or characters, built on the local engine.

steal_this: Offer a 'translate and dub my YouTube backlog' service to small creators this weekend — install it once, then charge per video.
